title: RaceLab — The job was saved. The worker wasn't.
disclosures: Actual Microsoft Edge application screenshots paced as stills, not continuous screen recording
Recorded Meta proposal recomputed locally; model and recheck waiting time omitted
One pinned repository method; real disposable SQLite and controlled process sequences, not a whole application or production benchmark
Generic synthetic English narration using Microsoft Zira Desktop
New RaceLab work by Tang Vu reuses earlier event Meta transport, budget and local infrastructure; TEND is an existing MIT source input

scenes.heading: The job was saved. The worker wasn't.
scenes.caption: New RaceLab work by Tang Vu. Reused event infrastructure; existing MIT TEND input. Actual UI stills / recorded Meta replay.
scenes.narration: RaceLab is new hackathon work by Tang Vu. It reuses Meta transport and local infrastructure from the earlier event prototype, LiveWorld. TEND is an existing MIT source input. Here is a familiar failure: a worker saves its claim, then stops. The job exists, but another worker cannot finish it.

scenes.heading: First, show that the original method works.
scenes.caption: Pinned claimNextDue method / unchanged input / real disposable SQLite / one local completion.
scenes.narration: RaceLab verifies the exact public source revision, extracts this TypeScript claim method, and executes it through a bounded SQLite adapter. Without interruption, one due job is claimed and completed. The original method passes. These process identifiers and transaction receipts come from the local execution.

scenes.heading: Stop after COMMIT. Reopen the same database.
scenes.caption: Actual worker exit and replacement process. Original method: 0 of 1 expected local completions; persisted row remains claimed.
scenes.narration: Now stop worker A after its claim commits. RaceLab observes its exit and starts worker B on the same database file. The original query only selects scheduled or retrying jobs. This row is already claimed, so it stays behind. The completion count is zero. The independent recovery check fails.

scenes.heading: Meta proposes the repair. Execution decides.
scenes.caption: Retained Muse Spark investigation: 2 requests / 1 original probe / 1 candidate / $0.015165 app estimate. Local replay makes no model call.
scenes.narration: Muse Spark inspected this method and the declared recovery contract. In the retained investigation, it ran a failing crash probe and proposed one replacement method. Check Meta repair executes that recorded proposal again locally, with no new model call. Worker B now reclaims the expired job. One local completion is recorded. Original A and candidate B remain inspectable.

scenes.heading: A reset is easy. Preserving the contract is harder.
scenes.caption: 10 declared conditions recomputed: fresh, expired, future, completed, retry, mixed rows, the exact lease boundary and a changed input.
scenes.narration: Recovering one job is not enough. A blanket reset could steal a healthy worker's claim. The fixed checker also requires preservation of fresh claims, future jobs, completed work, and payloads. It checks retries, mixed rows, the exact sixty second lease boundary, and a changed input. This candidate passes all ten declared conditions.

scenes.heading: When the old worker returns, its generation is stale.
scenes.caption: Actual stale-owner sequence. Durable generation increments; RaceLab's fixed fixture completion guard rejects the old generation.
scenes.narration: Inspect the expired owner condition. Worker B receives a newer durable generation. When worker A tries to complete with the old generation, the fixed local guard rejects it. Scrub the transaction trace to inspect what committed. This guard belongs to RaceLab's fixture. It does not establish exactly once delivery to an external service.

scenes.heading: Keep the failure. Take the evidence.
scenes.caption: Actual exported regression reopened through the file picker. Source and conditions execute again; imported model attribution is unverified.
scenes.narration: Export the regression and reopen that file. RaceLab discards supplied verdicts, traces, and process identifiers, then executes the source and conditions again. Imported model attribution is unverified. A method diff targets the pinned source. Editing clears old results, so a previous pass cannot silently survive a change.

scenes.heading: Make a repair an experiment you can challenge.
scenes.caption: One repository-derived study. New 60-second lease contract; bounded adapter and fixture effects. No whole-app, production or AI-superiority claim.
scenes.narration: This is one repository derived study, with a new lease contract, a bounded adapter, real SQLite, and controlled process sequences. It does not prove whole application correctness or general repair performance. RaceLab turns a model's proposed repair into evidence you can replay and challenge.
